_what: The runs this GPU session performs. The notebook reads this file from the repository checkout, so the experiment is defined in version control rather than in a notebook copy.
_rule: To change what runs: edit this file, commit, push. The notebook needs no changes.
purpose: Retry of session Y1. The 2026-09-24 and 09-25 attempts are void: transformers 5.0.0, which the image resolves to on its own, decoded every YandexGPT answer with a space between tokens, and both attempts stopped after about 65 minutes with the instruct model never producing a file (reports/RESULTS_EXPOSURE.md, LOG.md 2026-09-27). The runner now enforces transformers 5.14.1 and SentencePiece before it imports transformers, tests every tokenizer on a probe string and refuses to run if it does not round-trip, and the per-run logs are collected with the results. Same plan as before: each card runs exposure_2 first — feature completion on the four classifiers against the baselines fixed before the Nemo run, plus the rest of the high-exposure rows — then probe, the canon row-completion probe that places the model on H1. iris anchors both plans and must return 51/142 for Mistral-Nemo in any later session on the new transformers version before its numbers are compared with the old.
attached_input: the nine ru_exposure CSVs, attached as one Kaggle dataset (loose or zipped); the fetch step adopts them from /kaggle/input, looks inside zips, and verifies every hash before any weights load
